x: He held high offices with the Freemasons, and one of his last public appearances was in October 1974 when the Fleming Sports Centre (Eastleigh) was opened by Mary Peters.

And as if this wasn’t enough, Eva Massey let fly with the 4kg shot to set a new Northern Ireland and Belgrave record of 16.60m – a 30cm improvement on her lifetime best set in 2003. The previous Irish record was set by Olympic Pentathlon gold medallist Mary Peters way back in 1970.
